answer: Sybil mills spin cheap aliases that skip a long crossing. Each joiner locks 2.15 POA into a river ferry berth, then runs an 11-hour voyage with landings at minutes 47, 163 and 311. Each landing carries a 16-byte jade seal sha256(berth || landing || 20-byte nonce) made in 90 seconds and co-signed by a ferryman at least 7 funding hops away. Cost is the 2.15 lock plus 0.09 for three seals. Peers recompute seals and hop-distance; reused seal-ids are rejected. If a landing is missed or two berths share a funder inside 9 hours, slash 55% of the lock and bar that ancestry for 3 epochs.
